sources.title: Current official Papertrade FAQ markets
supports: FAQ currently lists BTC and ETH, both up to 1000x leverage; additional HIP-3 markets are a capability, not a current listing.
USDC balance and settlement infrastructure is described separately from traded underlyings.
limitations: Actually opened via web reader in the market-inventory update; no endpoint response bytes or precise transport timestamp were provided.
Official description does not establish deployed market activation, capacity or program parameters.

sources.title: Current official Jupiter YOLO overview markets
supports: Overview lists SOL, BTC, ETH, ZEC and HYPE, 500–1000x, with JupUSD collateral and payouts.
Other input tokens are swapped to JupUSD and are not additional YOLO trading markets.
limitations: Actually opened via web reader in the market-inventory update; no endpoint response bytes or precise transport timestamp were provided.
Official description does not establish deployed market activation, capacity or program parameters.
